title: Biosimilar Switch Incentive Schedule, Northbridge Specialty Tiers
content:
The Specialty Pharmacy Program offers a switch incentive on some tiers. A member who switches from a reference biologic to the preferred biosimilar pays zero member cost share for a set number of months.

## Reference biologic and preferred biosimilar

On every tier the pairing is the same: the reference biologic **Humira** has the preferred biosimilar **adalimumab-adaz**.

## Months of zero member cost share

| Tier | Months of zero member cost share after a switch to the preferred biosimilar |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | 0 (no incentive) |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | 0 (no incentive) |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | 3 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | 3 |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | 6 |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | 6 |

A figure of 0 means the tier offers no switch incentive.

## Questions on the schedule

- *Which drug earns the incentive?* Only adalimumab-adaz, when the member moves to it from Humira.
- *Which tiers give the longest incentive?* Northbridge Specialty Care Management and Northbridge Specialty Total Care, at 6 months each.
